## Decision Engine

This workflow uses deterministic routing and consumes no AI credits.

### Manual test
Run the workflow without input. It uses:

`Bu akşam ne yapayım?`

Expected route:

`daily_planner`

### Sub-workflow input
- `requestText`
- `userContext`
- `calendarContext`

### Output
- route
- agent workflow name
- confidence
- required context
- approval requirement
- discovery requirement
- safety flags

Later, Main Orchestrator will call this workflow and use its result to select the correct specialist agent.
